files.patch_reason: Husky-only closure: drop robot_pr2/robot_tiago/robot_hsr sources and the tmc_control_msgs catkin dependency (only robot_hsr.cpp used it). Husky RobotEnv/RobotHusky targets and flags (including the reference CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Debug) unchanged.

the bumper macro no longer applies <turnGravityOff>true</turnGravityOff> by default: it gets a parameter gravity_off (default false) and emits the tag only when gravity_off is true. In the reference every bumper link (chassis, wheels, arm, gripper) had gravity off, which leaves the Gazebo base undrivable (wheels hover/spin: 0.0075 m/s for a 0.2 m/s command, t3.2-motion-r1). Contact sensors, selfCollide=false and topics unchanged.
remove exec_depend on hsrb_description, hsrb_moveit_config and range_sensor_layer (HSR/range-sensor-only; range_sensor_layer has no Noetic binary and no launch/yaml references it).

import only RobotHusky and keep only the husky_ur5 branch (drive diff, ik group, robot_fn) plus the no-limit-joint default; other robots now fall through to the existing `Unknown env` ValueError. The husky_ur5 code path is unchanged (see diff: only deletions of other-robot branches and the pr2-specific no_lim_joints).

SAC.__init__: the compute device is read from args["device"] (default remains the reference torch.device("cuda")) because forem-dev has no visible GPU. The update functions (update_parameters, update_parameters_modified), networks, schedulers, alpha cap and checkpoint functions are unchanged byte for byte.
bind RobotEnv + RobotHusky only (PR2/Tiago/HSR classes are not compiled). The RobotEnv and RobotHusky bindings are byte-identical in the diff.

(1) remove the libgazebo_ros_moveit_planning_scene.so plugin block (prebuilt binary of unknown ABI, not in the source closure; RobotEnv does not use /planning_scene and reads joint_states). (2) pass gravity_off="true" to the 15 bumper macro calls of the UR5 arm links and gripper links so the ARM KEEPS the reference's gravity-free dynamics, while chassis/wheel/mount links get gravity (needed to drive). Measured: with gravity on for the arm too, the reference effort PID (p=100,d=0.1 on wrist_3, trajectory tolerance 0.1 rad) is violently unstable after random-policy episodes and arm resets abort ('wrist_3 path error', 'Could not set start pose after 50 trials'): t3.5-int-r2, t3.5-resets-r1, t3.5-resets-quick1; with the arm gravity-free: 12/12 episodes reset without failure (t3.5-resets-r2).
